location: Coffs Harbour, Mid North Coast, NSW, Australia
nicknames: Home of the Coffs Harbour Cup

main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). A spacious 1,630m Mid North Coast oval featuring a long, fair 420m home straight. The generous straight provides all running styles a fair opportunity, allowing closing swoopers ('S') ample runway to run down leaders on Good ground.
main_turf.post_bias: Fair across most starting points due to the 420m home straight. Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) offer a minor advantage from the 1000m and 1200m chute starts into the first bend.

handicapping_angles.fair_420m_straight_swooper_boost: Because Coffs Harbour features a spacious 420m home straight, do not penalize deep closers ('Swoopers'). Well-balanced gallopers with strong late sectionals excel here.
handicapping_angles.sydney_and_gold_coast_shippers: Coffs Harbour attracts top NSW Provincial/Metro yards and SE Queensland shippers (e.g. Kris Lees, Annabel Neasham, Matthew Dunn). Upgrade shippers coming off Randwick/Warwick Farm midweeks or Gold Coast provincial form (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.coffs_harbour_cup_showcase: During the Coffs Harbour Cup ($150k+) Showcase carnival in August, race quality elevates to Metro/Provincial grade. Factor in higher class offsets for Cup day feature races.
